rating.comments: Student supplied 300 students ('1.300') and a per-day figure and days ('2. 3'), then corrected the drink amount to 3 litres and days to 5 ('noi they eat 5 times a week and they drink 3 literrs'), which applies the AI's earlier prompts and partly revises the earlier value; no reasoning about why the steps multiply is shown. Later messages ('you do it') push the work back to the AI, and the student asked no questions. Ratings are based on short messages only, so the conversation is brief but judgeable.
